name: Bird-shaped jar
dimensions: H. 26.7 x W. (across handles) 35 x Diam. 32.6 cm (10 1/2 x 13 3/4 x 12 13/16 in.)
summary: Compressed, wide-bodied jar with open mouth, bulbous, off-center neck, flattened shoulders, sides tapering inward to a small, flat base, two strap lug handles embellished with crimped appliques, and a small triangular tab below the shoulder, opposite the mouth and neck; buff earthenware lightly burnished and decorated with geometric designs painted in black and burgundy slips before firing; decoration on the shoulders includes four round cartouches of small checkerboard patterns. Majiayao cultur
